tools.name: Umbrarium, preset demo
tools.line: The real Umbrarium dashboard computing exact answers over up to three million generated rows, entirely inside your browser tab. Click a chart to slice the rest, or run your own SQL.

tools.name: The Helix
tools.line: Paste DNA sequences and a column of measurements and see the double helix in the numbers: a score graded in your browser, with the controls that would expose a false win shown beside it.

tools.name: The Analyst
tools.line: Paste any data and profile it with a real SQL database in your browser: types, distributions, anomalies and hidden entities, then query it at a live SQL prompt.

tools.name: Prism
tools.line: A tiny language model that runs entirely in your browser: chat with it, have it write a story, watch one of its decisions on a map, then train your own copy on a foraging task or a price tape.

tools.name: Prose
tools.line: Paste in a body of text, mine its grammar in your browser, and recombine it into sentences and question and answer pairs for a training corpus.

tools.name: Council Spending Scanner
tools.line: English councils' published spending data, prepared ahead of time and opened one month at a time, with the same mechanical checks for every council.
